visual_notes: At phone size with the reader open, the large B1 Ring badge covers part of the B1 slot name.
The phone End turn subtitle sits at the lower edge and is partially clipped.
On PC, long shop names such as His Highness and Jenny wrap into stat-badge space.
Nest countdown badges work, but no current-to-landing tray appears. RecruitScreen._show_sky calls show_empty().
Cluricaun displays Ring +0 for +0.25 growth. See natural-fairies-ring-carry-1920x1080.png; src/ui/widgets/card_view.gd:211 uses an integer-only regex.
